blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Text-to-image diffusion models still struggle with complex prompts containing many elements and interactions. Existing attention-control methods mainly focus on controlling where elements appear, but often ignore how objects interact with each other. As a result, relation tokens describing interactions between elements may assign high attention to irrelevant regions, leading to missing or incorrect interactions. In this paper, we propose Graph2Scene, a training-free framework that treats scene graphs as a core control signal for diffusion generation. It represents elements as nodes and their relations as edges, and translates these element-relation dependencies into selective attention guidance. It grounds each element to its corresponding region and guides relational interactions among the involved elements. To achieve appropriate relation control without over-constraining the generation process, Graph2Scene further adapts the control duration to scene complexity and progressively relaxes graph guidance during denoising. Experiments on T2I-CompBench and ConceptMix show clear improvements in compositional generation, especially for object relations. On ConceptMix, Graph2Scene improves relationship accuracy from 0.59 to 0.84 over the strongest FLUX.1-based regional-control baseline. Results on LongBench-T2I further show its advantage on long and complex prompts.
blocks.zh: 文本到图像的传播模型仍然与包含许多元素和相互作用的复杂提示相抗衡. 现有的注意控制方法主要侧重于控制元素出现的地方,但经常忽略物体如何相互作用. 因此,描述各要素之间相互作用的关系符号可能会对不相关的区域给予高度关注,导致相互作用缺失或不正确。 在本文中,我们提出Graph2Scene,一个将场景图作为扩散生成核心控制信号的无培训框架. 它代表着作为节点的元素及其作为边缘的关系,并将这些元素关系依赖性转化为选择性的注意指导. 它将每个要素作为其相应区域的依据,并指导相关要素之间的关系互动。 为了在不过度限制生成过程的情况下实现适当的关系控制,Graph2Scene进一步调整了控制时间以适应场景的复杂性,并在解密时逐渐放松图表指导. 在T2I-CompBench和ConceptMix上的实验显示在组成生成方面有明显的改进,特别是在对象关系方面. 关于ConceptMix,Graph2Scene将关系精度从0.59提高到0.84,高于最强的FLUX.1区域控制基线. 关于Long Bench-T2I的结果进一步显示了它对长而复杂的提示的优势.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Text-to-image diffusion models [ 28 , 1 , 5 ] have made remarkable progress in generating realistic images from natural-language prompts. As model capabilities continue to advance, user demands are increasingly shifting toward complex prompts, where a target image may contain multiple objects with diverse attributes, spatial arrangements, and interactions [ 35 , 11 , 43 ] . However, faithfully generating such complex scenes remains challenging, as the model must accurately capture the semantic dependencies among objects, attributes, and relations from long text prompts and translate them into the corresponding visual content.
blocks.zh: 文本到图像传播模型[28, 1, 5]在从自然语言提示生成现实图像方面取得了显著进展. 随着模型能力的继续推进,用户的需求正越来越多地转向复杂的提示,即目标图像可能包含多个具有不同属性、空间安排和相互作用的物体[35、11、43]。 然而,忠实生成这种复杂的场景仍然具有挑战性,因为模型必须准确地捕捉对象,属性,以及长文本关系之间的语义依赖性,并把它们翻译为相应的视觉内容.

blocks.en:
In diffusion models, attention associates textual concepts with visual content during generation. Ideally, each text token should mainly influence the image region corresponding to its concept. However, in complex prompts, attention may spread to irrelevant regions, causing different concepts to interfere with each other.
We refer to this undesired behavior as attention leakage [ 31 , 7 , 41 ] .
Attention leakage can lead to incorrect attributes, object interference, or missing elements during generation [ 3 , 31 , 27 , 23 ] .
Existing attention-control methods alleviate this issue by introducing spatial constraints, such as bounding boxes or region masks, to restrict object-related tokens to their corresponding regions [ 18 , 32 , 36 , 21 , 39 ] .
blocks.zh:
在传播模型中,注意在生成过程中将文字概念与视觉内容联系起来. 理想的情况是,每个文本符号应主要影响与其概念相对应的图像区域. 然而,在复杂的提示中,注意力可能扩散到无关的区域,导致不同的概念相互干扰.
我们把这种不受欢迎的行为称为注意力渗漏[31,7,41].
注意渗漏可能导致不正确的属性、物体干扰或生成过程中缺失元素[3、31、27、23]。
现有的注意控制方法通过引入空间限制,如捆绑箱或区域面具,将与物体有关的标志限制在相应的区域[18,32,36,21,39]来缓解这一问题.

blocks.en:
Although existing methods can effectively place individual elements in their correct regions, they largely overlook attention leakage at the relation level. We conduct an experiment to verify that object-level layout control overlooks relation-level attention.
Figure 1 compares (A) generation without attention control, (B) object-level layout control following [ 4 ] (C) the same layout control, while restricting relation tokens to focus only on the related elements and their interaction regions.
Without attention control (Figure 1 (A)), the model fails to distinguish the regions of the girl and the boy, and the boy is missing. With layout control (Figure 1 (B)), the girl, boy, and balloon are generated in the correct regions with proper attributes. However, the relation token gives is not explicitly controlled, and its attention mainly focuses on the hand of an unrelated man rather than the girl, boy, and balloon involved in the interaction (as highlighted by the red box in Figure 1 (B)). As a result, the intended giving relation is not correctly generated. By restricting gives to attend to the related elements and their interaction region (Figure 1 (C)), the intended relation becomes much clearer. This experiment demonstrates that object-level layout control alone is insufficient, and relation tokens also require explicit attention control.
blocks.zh:
虽然现有方法可以有效地将单个要素置于正确的区域,但它们在很大程度上忽略了关系层面的注意力流失。 我们进行一项实验,以验证对象级布局控制忽略了关系级的注意.
图1比较了(A)生成时没有注意控制,(B)对象级布局控制后遵循[4](C)相同的布局控制,同时限制关系符只关注相关元素及其相互作用区域.
没有注意控制(图1(A)),模型无法区分女孩和男孩的地区,男孩失踪。 在布局控制(图1(B))下,女孩、男孩和气球是在具有适当属性的正确区域产生的。 然而,关系符所给出的信号并没有被明确控制,它的注意力主要集中于一个无关紧要的男人的手,而不是参与相互作用的姑娘,男孩和气球(如图1(B)中的红框所强调的). 因此,计划给予的关系产生不正确. 通过限制对相关要素及其互动区域的关注(图1(C)),预期的关系变得更加明确。 这一实验表明,单是对象级布局控制是不够的,关系符也要求明确注意控制.

blocks.en:
Effectively controlling relations in complex scenes requires identifying which elements are involved in each interaction.
Scene graphs naturally provide such a structure by representing elements as nodes and interactions as edges, making the dependencies in complex prompts explicit. However, using scene graphs to guide complex image generation raises two key challenges. First, a scene graph only describes these dependencies and cannot directly guide a diffusion model. We need to determine how to translate its nodes and edges into effective attention operations. Second, the attention control mechanism should adapt to different denoising stages [ 6 , 22 , 16 ] , while avoiding excessive intervention that may disturb the pretrained generation process.
blocks.zh:
有效控制复杂场景中的关系,需要确定每个互动中涉及哪些要素.
场景图通过将元素作为节点和相互作用作为边缘来表示,自然地提供了这样的结构,使复杂提示中的依赖性变得明确. 然而,使用场景图来指导复杂的图像生成提出了两个关键的挑战. 首先,场景图只描述这些依赖性,不能直接指导扩散模型. 我们需要确定如何将其节点和边缘转化为有效的关注行动。 第二,注意力控制机制应适应不同的去名阶段[6、22、16],同时避免可能扰乱预先训练的生成过程的过度干预。

blocks.en: To address these challenges, we propose Graph2Scene , a training-free framework that addresses relation control in complex text-to-image generation through two key designs. First, Graph2Scene introduces a graph-guided attention execution mechanism that converts scene graphs into structured attention operations. It explicitly models the correspondence between semantic concepts and visual regions: cross-attention associates relation concepts with their involved elements, while self-attention enables information propagation among graph-connected regions to reduce attention leakage and preserve object interactions. Second, Graph2Scene introduces a complexity-aware stage-wise execution strategy that estimates generation difficulty from attention patterns and adaptively determines when and how long graph control should be applied. This allows the framework to provide necessary guidance for challenging scenes while preserving the native generation ability of the pretrained model.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议采用无培训框架Graph2Scene,通过两种关键设计处理复杂的文本到图像生成中的关系控制。 首先,Graph2Scene引入了图导的注意执行机制,将场景图转换成结构化的注意操作. 它明确模拟语义概念和视觉区域之间的对应关系:交叉意向将相关概念与其相关要素联系起来,而自我意向则能够使信息在与图形相连的区域中传播,以减少注意力的渗漏,并保持物体的相互作用。 第二,Graph2Scene引入了一种复杂感知的阶段性执行策略,从关注模式中估计生成困难,并适应性地决定何时和应使用多长时间的图控. 这使得这个框架能够为具有挑战性的场景提供必要的指导,同时保留预先训练过的模型的本土生成能力.

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are as follows: • We identify that faithful generation of complex scenes requires explicit coordination of attention among interacting objects, beyond the object grounding and spatial control emphasized by existing methods. • Based on this observation, we propose Graph2Scene , a training-free framework that translates scene graphs into relation-aware attention control. It compiles element-relation dependencies into selective cross- and self-attention guidance and adaptively executes such guidance along the denoising trajectory according to scene complexity. • Extensive experiments on T2I-CompBench, ConceptMix, and LongBench-T2I show that Graph2Scene consistently improves compositional generation, especially on complex relation-rich scenes, improving relationship accuracy on ConceptMix from 0.42 to 0.84 compared with the FLUX.1 model.
blocks.zh: 简言之,我们的贡献如下: 我们确认,忠实的复杂场景需要明确协调相互作用的物体之间的注意力,超出现有方法所强调的物体搁浅和空间控制。 • 基于这一观察,我们提议采用无培训框架Graph2Scene,将场景图转换成了解关系的注意力控制。 它将元素关系依赖性汇编成有选择的交叉和自我注意指导,并根据场景复杂程度在去名化轨迹上适应性地执行这种指导. • T2I-Comp Bench,ConceptMix,和LongBench-T2I的大规模实验显示,Graph2Scene持续改善组成生成,特别是在复杂的关系丰富的场景上,与FLUX.1模型相比,ConceptMix上的关系精度从0.42提高到0.84.

blocks.en: We identify that faithful generation of complex scenes requires explicit coordination of attention among interacting objects, beyond the object grounding and spatial control emphasized by existing methods.
blocks.zh: 我们确认,忠实的复杂场景需要明确协调相互作用的物体之间的注意力,超出现有方法所强调的物体搁浅和空间控制。

blocks.en: Based on this observation, we propose Graph2Scene , a training-free framework that translates scene graphs into relation-aware attention control. It compiles element-relation dependencies into selective cross- and self-attention guidance and adaptively executes such guidance along the denoising trajectory according to scene complexity.
blocks.zh: 基于这一观察,我们提出Graph2Scene,一个将场景图转换成了解关系注意力控制的无训练框架. 它将元素关系依赖性汇编成有选择的交叉和自我注意指导,并根据场景复杂程度在去名化轨迹上适应性地执行这种指导.

blocks.en: Extensive experiments on T2I-CompBench, ConceptMix, and LongBench-T2I show that Graph2Scene consistently improves compositional generation, especially on complex relation-rich scenes, improving relationship accuracy on ConceptMix from 0.42 to 0.84 compared with the FLUX.1 model.
blocks.zh: T2I-Comp Bench,ConceptMix,以及Long Bench-T2I等广泛实验显示,Graph2Scene持续改善组成生成,特别是在复杂的关系丰富的场景上,与FLUX.1模型相比,ConceptMix上的关系精度从0.42提高到0.84.

blocks.en: 2 RELATED WORK
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Compositional Diffusion Generation.
blocks.zh: 2.1 成分分散生成。

blocks.en: Text-to-image diffusion models [ 28 , 1 , 5 ] can generate high-quality images from text. However, they often fail on compositional prompts with multiple objects, attributes, and relations. Common errors include missing objects, wrong attribute binding, and incorrect relations [ 7 , 23 ] . This has motivated many studies on compositional diffusion generation.
blocks.zh: 文本到图像传播模型[28, 1, 5]可以从文本中生成高质量的图像. 然而,它们往往在具有多个对象、属性和关系的构成提示上失败。 常见的错误包括缺失对象,错误属性绑定,以及不正确的关系[7,23]. 这推动了许多关于成分扩散生成的研究。

blocks.en:
One line of work injects external layout signals into the attention. GLIGEN [ 18 ] adds gated attention layers that take grounding boxes as input, and MS-Diffusion [ 32 ] trains an adapter
that binds reference subjects to given regions. These methods pre-train small modules, and then steer where each object appears.
blocks.zh:
一线工作为注意力注入外部布局信号. GLIGEN [18] 添加以搁浅箱作为输入的门式注意层,MS-Diffusion [32] 训练一个适配器
以特定区域为对象。 这些方法预排小模块,然后引导每个对象出现的地方.

blocks.en:
A second line of work directly constrains or optimizes the existing attention maps at inference time, without adding modules.Attend-and-Excite [ 3 ] strengthens the cross-attention responses of subject tokens during inference, preventing important concepts from being neglected in the generated image. Composable Diffusion [ 21 ] separately predicts the denoising direction for each concept and combines them at every diffusion step to generate all concepts together. Regional Prompt [ 4 ] splits the attention by region so each prompt attends to its own area. LLM-Blueprint [ 8 ] and RPG [ 39 ] further use an LLM to decompose complex prompts and plan object layouts before applying region-level generation or attention control. These methods reshape attention per object, but they treat each object on its own. Although these methods [ 11 , 24 ] consider interactions, they mainly focus on generating specific interaction patterns in simple scenes.
They rely on predefined HOI categories or learned interaction representations, and cannot generalize to diverse relations among multiple elements in complex scenes.
blocks.zh:
第二行的工作直接制约或优化了推断时间现有的关注图,而不添加模块. 出席-和-Excite [3]在推论中加强了主题符的交叉注意反应,防止重要概念在生成的图像中被忽视. 可编译扩散[21]单独预测每个概念的去诺化方向,并在每个扩散步骤将其结合,共同生成所有概念. 区域快讯[4]将注意力按区域划分,因此每个快讯都前往自己的地区。 LLM-Blueprint [8]和RPG [39]进一步使用LLM来分解复杂的提示并计划对象布局,然后应用区域级生成或注意力控制. 这些方法重塑了每个物体的注意力,但它们单独对待每个物体. 虽然这些方法[11,24]考虑相互作用,但它们主要侧重于在简单的场景中产生具体的相互作用模式.
它们依赖于预先定义的HOI类别或学到的交互表现,无法概括到复杂场景中多个要素之间的多样关系.

blocks.en: Overall, existing methods mainly improve compositional generation through object grounding, attribute binding, or layout control. Their guidance is largely defined at the object level and does not explicitly model the interactions among multiple elements. As scene complexity increases, this object-wise control is insufficient to capture relation-dependent generation, leading to incorrect or missing interactions even when individual objects are properly placed.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,现有方法主要通过物体搁浅,属性绑定,或布局控制来改进成分生成. 它们的指导主要是在对象层面定义的,没有明确地模拟多个要素之间的相互作用。 随着场景复杂性的增加,这种面向对象的控制不足以捕捉依赖关系的生成,导致不正确或缺失的相互作用,即使单个对象被妥善放置.

blocks.en: 2.2 Scene Graphs for Diffusion Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 传播模型的场景图

blocks.en:
Scene graphs are also used to represent objects and relations in complex scenes. Existing methods mainly differ in how the graph is converted into a generation condition. SG2Im [ 14 ] uses a GCN to encode the graph and
predict object layouts. SGDiff [ 38 ] learns graph or relation embeddings. CanonicalSg2Im [ 9 ] learns canonical graph representations to handle
semantically equivalent graphs. SG-Adapter [ 29 ] uses graph triplets to refine text embeddings.
R3CD [ 20 ] further models relations with a graph transformer and relation-aware attention objectives.
blocks.zh:
场景图也用于代表复杂场景中的物体和关系. 现有方法主要在如何将图表转换成生成条件上有所不同. SG2Im [14] 使用GCN编码图和
预测对象布局。 SGDiff [38] 学习图表或关系嵌入. Canonical Sg2Im [9] 学习用canonical图示处理
示众等图. SG-Adapter [29] 使用图三进制来完善文本嵌入.
R3CD [20] 与图形变压器和了解关系关注目标进一步建立模型关系.

blocks.en: Most existing scene graph-based methods focus on scene graph-to-image generation, where scene graphs are directly used as inputs to graph-conditioned generators or trained graph encoders. In contrast, Graph2Scene does not train a new graph-conditioned generation model, but explores how to execute scene graph constraints on a pretrained text-to-image diffusion model through attention control. Therefore, in the main experiments, we mainly compare with existing compositional generation methods built upon pretrained T2I models, while providing additional comparisons with scene graph-based generation methods in Section C of the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 大多数现存的场景图法注重场景图成像生成,场景图法直接用作图形条件化的生成器或训练有素的图形编码器的输入. 相比之下,Graph2Scene并不训练一个新的图形条件生成模型,而是探索如何通过注意力控制执行预训文本到图像传播模型的场景图形限制. 因此,在主要实验中,我们主要与基于预先训练的T2I模型的现有组成生成方法进行比较,同时在补充材料C节中提供与场景图形生成方法的额外比较.

blocks.en: 3 Graph2Scene
blocks.zh: 3 图2 场景

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Workflow of Graph2Scene.
blocks.zh: 图2:图2场景的工作流程。

blocks.en: As shown in Figure. 2 , Graph2Scene consists of three main components. First, we construct a scene graph from a complex text prompt. Each element node contains its semantic description and predicted layout, while each relation edge connects the corresponding elements involved in an interaction. Second, we compile the scene graph into attention masks for the frozen Diffusion Transformer. In cross-attention, the masks control the association between text tokens and image regions, so that element descriptions attend to their target regions and relation tokens are bound to the regions of the elements involved in each interaction. In self-attention, the masks restrict information exchange according to the graph structure, allowing communication within each element region and between graph-connected regions, which further reduces attention leakage across unrelated regions. Third, we apply these graph-based controls along the denoising trajectory with a stage-wise schedule. The control duration is determined by the estimated scene complexity, allowing the framework to adjust the execution process across different denoising stages.
blocks.zh: 如图所示。 2,图2场景由三个主要部分组成. 首先,我们用复杂的文本提示构建一个场景图。 每个元素节点包含其语义描述和预测布局,而每个关系边缘连接一个相互作用中涉及的相应元素. 第二,我们把场景图编成注意罩 用于冷冻的传播变形器 在交叉作用中,口罩控制了文本符号和图像区域之间的关联,因此元素描述会关注其目标区域,关系符号会绑定在每次互动中涉及元素的区域. 在自觉性中,口罩按照图表结构限制信息交流,使每个元素区域内部和图连接区域之间的通信得以进行,这进一步减少了无关区域的注意力渗漏. 第三,我们采用这些以图表为基础的控制,沿去诺的轨迹,并采用分阶段时间表。 控制持续时间由场景估计复杂度决定,使框架能够在不同调试阶段调整执行过程.

blocks.en: 3.1 Hierarchical Scene Graph Construction
blocks.zh: 3.1 分级地貌图建设

blocks.en: Graph2Scene represents a complex prompt as a scene graph of elements and their relations, making the structural dependencies in the prompt explicit. Specifically, we use a vision–language model (VLM) to parse the prompt into a hierarchical representation with a global scene and individual element nodes. Each element node stores its semantic description and predicted layout information, including its bounding box. Each edge connects two element nodes and specifies their relation, such as holding or next to. The graph explicitly represents where each element should appear and how different elements should interact, providing structured guidance for attention computation during the subsequent denoising process. Construction examples and prompt templates are provided in Sections A and D of the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: Graph2Scene作为元素及其关系的场景图,代表了一个复杂的提示,使得迅速中的结构依赖性变得明确. 具体地说,我们使用一种视觉语言模型(VLM)来解析迅速变成一个带有全球场景和单个元素节点的分级代表. 每个元素节点存储其语义描述和预测布局信息,包括其边框. 每个边缘连接两个元素节点并指定它们的关系,例如持有或旁边. 该图明确显示每个元素的出现地点和不同元素应如何相互作用,为在随后的解密过程中的注意力计算提供结构化指导. 补充材料A和D节提供了施工实例和快速模板。

blocks.en: 3.2 Graph guided selective attention computation
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 图表 选择性注意计算

blocks.en: To ensure that relational concepts interact with their corresponding elements, Graph2Scene introduces a customized attention mask mechanism for the MM-DiT backbone. The mask is constructed from the scene graph structure, including the topology of nodes and edges, as well as the layout and semantic information associated with each node and edge.
blocks.zh: 为确保关系概念与其相应的要素相互作用,Graph2Scene为MM-DIT主干线引入了定制的注意罩机制. 面具由场景图结构构建,包括节点和边缘的地形,以及与每个节点和边缘相关的布局和语义信息.

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 3 , Graph2Scene converts the scene graph into structured attention computation through a customized attention mask, which regulates information flow in the MM-DiT backbone. Graph2Scene performs graph-guided attention through two operations: text-image cross-attention and relation-guided self-attention. The text-image cross-attention computation (➋) associates text tokens with image tokens. Element tokens are connected to their corresponding image regions, while relation tokens are connected to the regions of all participating elements. This provides layout grounding and binds each relation to its related elements. The relation-guided self-attention computation (➌) controls information exchange among image tokens. Tokens within the same element region can interact with each other, while tokens from different regions can exchange information only when their corresponding elements are connected in the scene graph. Together with text self-attention (➊), these operations define the graph-guided attention computation, which is integrated into the full MM-DiT attention (➍).

blocks.en:
Graph-guided attention control should be adaptive rather than applied with a fixed strategy for all prompts.
First, continuous attention control throughout generation may harm the model’s native generation ability, so the control should be stopped in time once sufficient guidance has been provided.
Second, relation control should follow layout control, since diffusion models typically establish object layouts before refining semantic relations and visual details [ 16 , 26 ] .
blocks.zh:
图表指导的注意力控制应当是适应性的,而不是对所有提示采用固定的战略。
首先,在一代人中持续控制注意力可能损害模型的本土生成能力,因此一旦提供足够的指导,就应及时停止控制。
其次,关系控制应该遵循布局控制,因为扩散模型通常在完善语义关系和视觉细节之前先建立对象布局[16,26].

blocks.en:
We monitor the attention distributions of specific text tokens during generation to guide the adaptive adjustment of control strength. These attention distributions reveal two typical generation problems: attention overlap and attention leakage.
Attention overlap occurs when the high-score attention of different tokens concentrates on largely the same spatial regions.
Attention leakage occurs when the high-score attention distribution of a token extends beyond the region of its corresponding concept. Figure 4 illustrates both cases: in example (a), the attention maps of boy and girl overlap heavily, causing the girl to be missing, while in example (b), the relation tokens pushes and pulls fail to focus on their corresponding regions, leading to incorrect relation generation.
blocks.zh:
我们监测特定文字符号在生成过程中的注意力分布,以指导控制强度的适应性调整. 这些注意力分布揭示了两个典型的生成问题:注意力重叠和注意力渗漏.
当不同信物的高分注意力集中在基本相同的空间区域时,就会出现注意力重叠.
当一个符号的高分注意力分布超出其相应概念的区域时,就会发生注意力渗漏。 图4说明了这两种情况:例如(a),男童和女童的注意力分布图严重重叠,导致女童失踪,而(b),关系标志则推动和拉动没有侧重于相应的区域,导致产生关系不正确。

Based on these attention behaviors, we first perform a warm-up generation without additional guidance and collect the attention distributions of the selected text tokens. We then measure the severity of attention overlap and attention leakage from these attention maps. For prompts with more severe attention overlap or leakage, Graph2Scene applies stronger and longer graph guidance.
The detailed calculation is provided in Section E of the supplementary material.

基于这些关注行为,我们首先在不附加指导的情况下进行热身一代,并收集选定文本符号的关注分布. 然后,我们测量注意力的严重程度 重叠和注意力渗漏 从这些注意力地图。 对于注意重度重叠或渗漏的提示,Graph2Scene应用了更强和更长的图表指导.
详细计算见补充材料E节。

blocks.en: Graph2Scene progressively shifts the control focus from layout guidance to relation guidance during denoising. This design follows how diffusion models gradually form the layout first and refine semantics and interactions later. Since this transition is gradual and continuous [ 40 ] , we linearly decrease the layout guidance weight from 1 to 0 and increase the relation guidance weight from 0 to 1 over the determined control duration.
blocks.zh: Graph2Scene在解析时逐渐将控制焦点从布局引导转向关系引导. 这种设计遵循的是扩散模型如何先逐渐形成布局,后细化语义和相互作用. 由于这种过渡是渐进和连续的[40],我们线性地将布局制导权重从1降至0,并在确定的控制期内将关系制导权重从0提高到1.

blocks.en:
Datasets. We evaluate Graph2Scene on two complementary benchmarks covering different levels of scene complexity. T2I-CompBench [ 13 ] evaluates compositional generation, including attribute binding and object relationships, using relatively concise prompts. For complex scenes, motivated by prior efforts to construct semantically challenging prompts [ 25 , 42 ] , we adapt the concept-mixing strategy of ConceptMix [ 35 ] to construct prompts with controllable compositional complexity. Specifically, we extend the concept range to K ∈ [ 8 , 20 ] K\in[8,20] and introduce an additional interaction dimension to increase the density of inter-object relationships.
We additionally report qualitative results on the long-prompt benchmark LongBench-T2I [ 43 ] in Section G of the supplementary material.

我们还在补充材料G节中报告了长期快速基准LongBench-T2I[43]的质量结果。

We compare Graph2Scene with representative compositional and controllable generation methods, including Composable Diffusion [ 21 ] , GLIGEN [ 18 ] , Attend-and-Excite [ 3 ] , MS-Diffusion [ 32 ] , RPG [ 39 ] . Since these methods are built on different diffusion backbones, we follow their
official implementations and recommended settings. We additionally include FLUX.1 and the FLUX.1-based Regional Prompt for direct same-backbone comparison [ 4 ] . Runtime comparisons with Regional Prompt across different prompt lengths and image resolutions are reported in Section F of the supplementary material.

blocks.en: We adopt complementary evaluation protocols for scenes of varying complexity. For simple compositional generation, we follow the official evaluation protocol of T2I-CompBench to ensure comparability with existing methods. In addition, we apply a VLM-based evaluation protocol to both simple and complex scenes, following recent approaches [ 12 , 17 , 37 ] . Specifically, we evaluate prompt faithfulness along three dimensions: Acc exist \mathrm{Acc}_{\mathrm{exist}} , Acc attribute \mathrm{Acc}_{\mathrm{attribute}} , and Acc relationship \mathrm{Acc}_{\mathrm{relationship}} , measuring element presence, attribute binding, and relationship correctness, respectively. Additionally, we report CLIPScore [ 10 ] , HPSv2 [ 34 ] , and PickScore [ 15 ] to assess global text–image alignment and perceptual quality. For consistency, we use Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct [ 30 ] to construct layouts for all baselines and evaluate the corresponding prompt-faithfulness metrics. The VLM evaluation prompt templates are provided in Section D of the supplementary material.

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparison on Simple Scenes
blocks.zh: 4.2 简单情景比较

blocks.en: We first evaluate Graph2Scene on T2I-CompBench, which targets relatively simple scenes: object existence, attribute binding, and spatial composition. Existing methods improve these aspects by editing the prompt or adding spatial conditions. However, they mostly ground objects at the object level and leave the visual interactions to the diffusion model. When several objects compete for the same attention, attributes still leak between them and object counts still go wrong. Graph2Scene adds graph-guided self-attention, which lets related regions exchange information during denoising. This further improves quality, reaching 0.94, 0.80, and 0.89 on existence, attribute, and relationship accuracy, respectively. Compared with the strongest regional control baseline, Regional Prompt, Graph2Scene improves attribute accuracy from 0.69 to 0.80 and relationship accuracy from 0.73 to 0.89. This shows that explicit interaction modeling remains beneficial even for simple scenes.
blocks.zh: 我们首先在T2I-Comp Bench上评价Graph2Scene,它针对的是相对简单的场景:物体的存在,属性绑定,以及空间构成. 现有方法通过编辑即时或增加空间条件来改善这些方面. 然而,它们大多是在物体层面地面物体,并将视觉相互作用留给扩散模型. 当几个对象争夺同样的关注时,它们之间的属性仍然泄露,对象计数仍然是错误的. Graph2Scene增加了以图表为指南的自我注意,让相关区域在解密时交换信息. 这进一步提高了质量,在存在,属性和关系准确性方面分别达到0.94,0.80和0.89. 与最强的区域控制基线相比,Regional Power,Graph2Scene提高了属性精度,从0.69提高到0.80,关系精度从0.73提高到0.89. 这表明,即使对简单的场景来说,明确的互动模型仍然有益。

blocks.en: 4.3 Comparison on Complex Scenes
blocks.zh: 4.3 复杂情景比较

blocks.en: We then evaluate Graph2Scene on ConceptMix, where each prompt combines many concepts and interactions. As shown in Table 2 , Graph2Scene ranks first on five of the six metrics and ties for the best on the last one. It reaches 0.74 on Acc attribute {}_{\text{attribute}} and 0.84 on Acc relationship {}_{\text{relationship}} . It also gives the best existence accuracy (0.88), and CLIPScore (26.45), and its HPSv2 (0.29) matches the top baseline. The gap is largest on relationships, which is exactly what our method targets.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们评价Graph2Scene on ConceptMix,其中每个提示结合了许多概念和相互作用. 如表2所示,Graph2Scene在6个衡量标准中的5个中排名第一,在最后一个衡量标准中排名最佳。 在 Acc 属性 QQText{属性 {属性 } 上达到0.74, 在 Acc 关系 QQText{关联 } 上达到0.84. 它还给出了最佳存在精确度(0.88)和CLIPScore(26.45),其HPSv2(0.29)与顶级基线匹配. 在关系上差距最大,这正是我们的方法目标。

blocks.en: Most baselines perform poorly on complex prompts, partly because several of them use older SD-based backbones, while layout-based methods mainly control where objects appear rather than how they interact. For a fairer comparison, we focus on methods using the same FLUX.1 backbone. The base FLUX.1 achieves 0.75 on Acc exist {}_{\text{exist}} but only 0.42 on Acc relationship {}_{\text{relationship}} . Regional Prompt improves attribute accuracy to 0.64 and relationship accuracy to 0.59 by assigning separate prompts to different regions, but many interactions are still missing. RPG shows a similar limitation on a weaker backbone, with only 0.09 relationship accuracy. These results indicate that region-level control helps object placement and attribute binding, but is still insufficient for modeling interactions in complex scenes.
blocks.zh: 大多数基线在复杂的提示上表现不佳,部分原因是其中几个使用了更古老的基于SD的骨干,而基于布局的方法主要控制物体出现的地方,而不是它们如何相互作用. 为了进行更公平的比较,我们侧重于使用相同的FLUX.1主干线的方法。 FLUX.1的基础在 Acc 存在 QQText{存在 {但只在 Acc 关系 QQText{关系}上达到 0.42 . 区域快速将属性精确度提高到0.64,关系精确度提高到0.59,方法是向不同区域指定单独的提示,但许多互动仍然缺失。 RPG在较弱的骨干上表现出类似的限制,关系精度只有0.09. 这些结果表明,区域一级的控制有助于物体的放置和属性绑定,但仍然不足以模拟复杂场景中的相互作用.

blocks.en: Graph2Scene closes this gap. It does not stop at placing elements. Its graph edges let related regions share information during denoising. This way, the model builds the interaction between elements. On the same FLUX.1 backbone, the relationship score rises from 0.59 to 0.84, and attributes and existence also improve. This shows that the gain comes from relation-level control, not from a stronger base model. Additional qualitative comparisons on simple scenes and complex scenes at different complexity levels are provided in Section G of the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 图2 场景关闭了此缺口 。 它不停止于放置元素。 它的图边让相关区域在解密时共享信息. 这样,模型构建了元素之间的相互作用. 在相同的FLUX.1骨干上,关系得分从0.59升至0.84,属性和存在性也得到改善. 这表明收益来自关系级控制,而不是更强大的基础模型. 补充材料G节提供了不同复杂程度的简单场景和复杂场景的其他定性比较。

blocks.en: Effect of the layout–relation ratio ( α , β ) (\alpha,\beta) . We next fix the two control strengths to different values and compare them with our dynamic schedule. As shown in Figure 6(c) , no fixed ratio works well. Using layout alone ( 1 , 0 ) (1,0) already gives 0.64 on attributes and 0.59 on relationships. Surprisingly, any fixed mix does worse. The balanced setting ( 0.5 , 0.5 ) (0.5,0.5) drops to 0.24 and 0.37, and the relation-only setting ( 0 , 1 ) (0,1) drops to 0.07 and 0.27. The reason is timing. A fixed β \beta applies relation control from the very first step, before the layout is settled. The two controls then fight each other, and both attributes and relationships suffer. Our dynamic schedule avoids this. It lets layout form first, adds relation control later, and then releases both. This raises all three metrics to the highest values (0.88, 0.74, 0.84), and matches how diffusion models build an image from layout to detail.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we present Graph2Scene, a training-free framework that compiles scene graphs into attention control for compositional text-to-image generation. Based on the observation that existing attention-control methods mainly focus on individual element placement while overlooking inter-object relations, Graph2Scene explicitly models both elements and their interactions through graph-guided attention. Our framework converts scene graph structures into layout- and relation-aware attention constraints, and applies them at different denoising stages with a complexity-aware control schedule.
Graph2Scene is compatible with existing diffusion models without additional training and can be directly applied to complex prompts with multiple interacting elements. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Graph2Scene improves compositional generation quality, especially for complex scenes with dense interactions.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们介绍了Graph2Scene,一个将场景图集成到注意控件的无培训框架,用于组成文本到图像生成. 基于现有注意控制方法主要侧重于单个元素的放置,同时俯瞰对象间关系的观点,Graph2Scene通过图表引导的注意,明确模拟元素及其相互作用. 我们的框架将场景图结构转换为布局-和关系-意识的注意力限制,并在不同的解密阶段加以应用,具有复杂-意识的控制时间表.
Graph2Scene与现有的传播模型兼容,无需额外训练,可以直接应用于具有多个相互作用元素的复杂提示. 广泛的实验表明,Graph2Scene提高了组成生成质量,特别是对于具有密集相互作用的复杂场景.

blocks.en: Appendix A Graph Construction Details
blocks.zh: 附录A 图表建筑细节

blocks.en: Graph2Scene constructs the scene graph directly from the input prompt using Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct [ 30 ] . As illustrated in Figure 1 , we prompt the VLM to organize the scene information into three parts: global information describing the overall scene and style, individual elements with their descriptions and predicted bounding boxes, and relations specifying how pairs of elements interact. The extracted information is returned in a structured JSON format, where elements correspond to graph nodes and relations correspond to graph edges.
blocks.zh: Graph2Scene直接从使用Quen3-VL-8B-Instruct [30] 的输入提示中构建场景图. 如图1所示,我们促使VLM将场景信息组织成三个部分:描述整体场景和风格的全局信息,带有描述和预测边框的单个元素,以及说明对元素如何相互作用的关系. 提取的信息以结构化的JSON格式返回,其中元素对应图表节点,关系对应图表边缘.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Prompt-to-JSON conversion template used in Graph2Scene.
blocks.zh: 图1:Graph2Scene中使用的快速到JSON转换模板.

blocks.en: Each element node contains four basic properties. id uniquely identifies the element, while type records its semantic category. bbox specifies the predicted spatial region of the element in the image, and desc provides its local visual description, including appearance and attributes. These properties provide the semantic and spatial information required to associate each element with its corresponding text and image tokens.
blocks.zh: 每个元素节点包含四个基本属性. id独占地识别元素,而类型则记录其语义类. bbox指定了图像中元素的预测空间区域,desc提供了它的局部视觉描述,包括外观和属性. 这些属性提供了将每个元素与相应的文本和图像符号联系起来所需的语义和空间信息.

blocks.en: Each relation edge describes an interaction between two element nodes. source and target specify the participating elements, type records the relation category, and direction indicates its direction when applicable. description provides a natural-language description of the relation, which is used to identify the corresponding relation tokens for subsequent attention control. Each edge also has a unique id for reference.
blocks.zh: 每个关系边缘都描述了两个元素节点之间的相互作用. 源和目标指定了参与要素,类型记录了关系类别,并在适用时指明方向。 描述提供了关系的自然语言描述,用于识别相应的关系符,用于后续的注意控制. 每个边也有一个独特的ID来参考.

blocks.en: In addition to elements and relations, we separately organize scene-level information that applies to the entire image. This information includes the background, overall visual style, lighting, viewpoint, and other imaging conditions. Such global descriptions are shared across all elements and relations rather than being associated with a specific node or edge.
blocks.zh: 除了元素和关系外,我们还单独组织适用于整个图像的场景级信息. 这些信息包括背景,整体视觉风格,照明,视角,以及其他成像条件. 这种全球描述在所有要素和关系中都有,而不是与具体节点或边缘相关联。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Organization of image information in Graph2Scene.
blocks.zh: 图 2: 图2景中图像信息的编排.

blocks.en: During graph construction, the VLM also organizes the original prompt according to the extracted structure. Scene-level descriptions are retained as global information, while element and relation descriptions are associated with their corresponding nodes and edges. The resulting structured prompt is used as the textual condition for generation, allowing Graph2Scene to identify the text tokens associated with each element and relation during attention control.
blocks.zh: 在图建过程中,VLM还根据提取的结构组织原始的速报. 场景级描述作为全局信息保留,而元素和关系描述则与其相应的节点和边缘相关. 由此形成的结构化的提示作为生成的文字条件,使Graph2Scene能够识别在注意控制期间与每个元素和关系相关的文字符号.

blocks.en: Appendix B Analysis of Graph Control Duration
blocks.zh: 附录B 图表控制期限分析

blocks.en: Modern diffusion Transformers are pretrained with full attention, where each token can interact with all other tokens during denoising. Graph2Scene modifies this process at inference time by restricting some interactions according to the scene graph. Such control helps the model better establish object layouts and relations. However, the pretrained model is not optimized for this modified attention pattern throughout the entire denoising process. If the control is applied for too many steps, the model increasingly deviates from its original full-attention behavior and cannot properly adapt to the modified attention computation [ 4 , 33 ] . As a result, the generation process becomes unstable and may eventually produce severe visual artifacts.
blocks.zh: 现代传播 变形器在全心全意的训练下进行预训,其中每个令牌可以在除号时与所有其他令牌相互作用. 图2 场景通过根据场景图限制一些相互作用,在推断时间修改了这个过程. 这种控制有助于模型更好地建立对象布局和关系. 然而,预先训练的模型并没有在整个消音过程中为这种修改后的注意模式进行优化. 如果控制被应用到太多的步骤上,该模型越来越偏离其最初的全心全意行为,无法正确适应修改后的注意计算[4,33]. 因此,生成过程变得不稳定,最终可能会产生严重的视觉文物.

blocks.en:
This phenomenon is also consistently observed in our experiments. As shown quantitatively in Figure 6(a) and (b) of the main paper,
generation quality drops sharply when the control is extended beyond about 20 denoising steps. When the control horizon reaches 25 steps or more, many generated images are close to complete collapse and no longer contain recognizable visual content. The qualitative examples in
Figure 3 further illustrate this behavior. Slight artifacts already appear around step 20, and become increasingly severe as the control duration increases. These results show that, under the attention modification used by Graph2Scene, longer control does not continuously improve generation. Instead, excessive control increasingly interferes with the pretrained model’s original full-attention generation process and eventually leads to unstable generation or visual collapse.
blocks.zh:
在我们的实验中也不断观察到这种现象。 如主要文件图6(a)和(b)所示,
当控制扩展到超过约20个去名步骤时,生成质量急剧下降。 当控制视野达到25步或以上时,许多生成的图像接近完全崩溃,不再包含可识别的视觉内容. 定性实例
图3进一步说明了这种行为。 轻微的文物已经出现在第20步周围,随着控制期限的延长而变得越来越严重. 这些结果表明,在Graph2Scene使用的注意修改下,较长的控制并不能持续改善生成. 相反,过度的控制越来越干扰了预先训练的模型最初全心全意的生成过程,并最终导致不稳定的生成或视觉崩溃.

blocks.en: Appendix C Additional Comparison with Scene Graph-Based Methods
blocks.zh: 附录C 与场景图形方法的比较

blocks.en: Scene graph-based generation methods aim to address the same fundamental challenge as Graph2Scene: generating images with accurate objects, attributes, and relational interactions from structured descriptions. Therefore, we further compare Graph2Scene with representative scene graph-based approaches, including SG2IM [ 14 ] , SGDiff [ 38 ] , and CanonicalSg2Im [ 9 ] , to evaluate the effectiveness of explicitly executing scene graph constraints during the generation process.
blocks.zh: 基于场景图的生成方法旨在解决与Graph2Scene相同的根本挑战:通过结构化描述生成带有精确对象,属性和关系相互作用的图像. 因此,我们进一步将图2场景与有代表性的场景图表方法进行比较,包括SG2IM [14],SGDiff [38],以及CanonicalSg2Im [9],以评估在生成过程中明确执行场景图表限制的有效性.

blocks.en: Table 2: Quantitative comparison with scene graph-based methods.
blocks.zh: 表2:与场景图表法的定量比较.

blocks.en:
All compared scene graph-based methods provide publicly available models trained on the COCO dataset [ 19 ] .
We directly use their released COCO checkpoints for inference and evaluate all methods on the COCO-Stuff dataset [ 2 ] with an NVIDIA L20 GPU under the same experimental setting.
Following our main experiments, we adopt the same evaluation metrics, including object existence accuracy ( Acc exist \mathrm{Acc}_{\mathrm{exist}} ), attribute accuracy ( Acc attribute \mathrm{Acc}_{\mathrm{attribute}} ), relationship accuracy ( Acc relationship \mathrm{Acc}_{\mathrm{relationship}} ), CLIPScore, HPSv2, and PickScore, to measure both semantic alignment and overall generation quality.
blocks.zh:
所有比对的场景图法都提供了在COCO数据集上受过训练的公开模型[19].
我们直接使用他们释放的COCO检查站进行推断,并评估COCO-Stuff数据集上的所有方法[2],在同一个实验环境下有一个NVIDIA L20 GPU.
在主要实验之后,我们采用了相同的评价度量,包括物体存在精度(Acc存在\mathrm{Acc}_{\mathrm{存在}),属性精度(Acc属性\mathrm{Acc}_{\mathrm{atpitation}),关系精度. (Acc关系\mathrm{Acc\ mathrm{ relationship } ),CLIPScore,HPSv2和PickScore,既测量语义上的对齐,又测量整体生成质量.

blocks.en:
Table 2 shows that Graph2Scene consistently outperforms existing scene graph-based methods across all metrics. SG2IM uses graph convolutions to predict layouts and a GAN-based refinement network for generation.
SGDiff employs masked contrastive pre-training to encode scene graphs into a latent diffusion model. CanonicalSg2Im learns canonical graph representations to handle semantically equivalent graphs. However, these methods struggle with visual fidelity due to limited generation capacity and imperfect alignment between graph structures and visual content. In contrast, Graph2Scene leverages a powerful pretrained text-to-image diffusion backbone and explicitly compiles scene graph structures into attention operations. This design integrates structural constraints while preserving the model’s native generation ability.
As a result, Graph2Scene achieves substantial improvements in object existence, attribute recognition, and relationship accuracy, reaching scores of 0.927, 0.893, and 0.872, respectively. These results demonstrate more effective preservation of scene semantics and interactions compared with previous scene graph-based approaches. Moreover, Graph2Scene obtains higher overall visual quality scores, achieving a CLIPScore of 26.296, an HPSv2 score of 0.294, and a PickScore of 22.845, indicating better alignment with both image-text similarity and human preference.
blocks.zh:
表2显示,图2场景在所有度量中一贯优于基于场景图的现有方法。 SG2IM使用图解来预测布局和基于GAN的精细网络进行生成.
SGDiff使用蒙面的对比性预训,将场景图表编码成潜在的扩散模型. Canonical Sg2Im 学习了canonical图表达法,可以处理模态等效图. 然而,由于生成能力有限和图结构和视觉内容不完美地对齐,这些方法与视觉忠心相搏. 相比之下,Graph2Scene利用了强大的预训文本到图像传播主干线,并明确将场景图结构编译成关注操作. 这种设计结合了结构限制,同时保留了模型的本土生成能力.
因此,Graph2Scene在对象存在,属性识别和关系精度方面都取得了实质性的改进,分别达到0.927,0.893和0.872的分数. 这些结果表明,与以往的场景图法相比,场景语义学和相互作用得到更有效的保存. 此外,Graph2Scene获得了较高的整体视觉质量分数,实现了26.296的CLIPScore,0.294的HPSv2分数和22.845的PickScore,表明与图像文本的相似性和人类偏好都更加一致.

blocks.en:
Figure 4 presents qualitative comparisons on the COCO-Stuff dataset.
Although all methods receive the same scene graph conditions, Graph2Scene produces significantly clearer and more realistic images while preserving the specified objects and relationships.
This improvement is mainly attributed to the stronger generative capability of modern diffusion backbones and the explicit execution of scene graph constraints during generation.
In contrast, previous scene graph-based methods are built upon earlier generation architectures, such as GAN-based pipelines or early scene graph-conditioned diffusion models, which often suffer from limited visual fidelity and difficulty in aligning graph structures with image contents.
As shown in Figure 4 , SGDiff can generate some recognizable scene elements, such as the person and skateboard, but many details remain blurry and incomplete.
For SG2IM and CanonicalSg2Im, although the generated images contain rough color distributions and coarse object regions, the objects are often heavily distorted, making their categories and attributes difficult to identify.
For example, the shopping cart, city street, and bicycle structures are only weakly represented, and the generated contents lack clear boundaries and realistic appearances.
blocks.zh:
图4提供了COCO-Stuff数据集的质量比较。
虽然所有方法都得到了相同的场景图条件,但Graph2Scene在保留指定对象和关系的同时,会产生明显更清晰和更现实的图像.
这一改进主要归功于现代传播骨干更强大的基因能力,以及生成过程中明确执行场景图限制.
相比之下,之前的场景图法都是建立在早期的生成架构之上,如基于GAN的管道或早期场景图条件的传播模型,它们往往受到视觉上的忠诚度有限,难以将图法结构与图像内容对齐.
如图4所示,SGDiff可以生成一些可识别的场景元素,如人物和滑板,但许多细节仍然模糊和不完整.
对于SG2IM和CanonicalSg2Im来说,虽然生成的图像包含粗糙的颜色分布和粗糙的物体区域,但物体往往被严重扭曲,使其类别和属性难以识别.
例如,购物车,城市街道和自行车结构只是代表性薄弱,生成的内容缺乏明确的界限和现实的外观.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Case studies comparing Graph2Scene with existing Scene Graph based methods on the COCO-Stuff dataset.
blocks.zh: 图4:根据COCO-Stuff数据集,将Graph2Scene与现有SceneGraph方法进行比较的案例研究.

blocks.en:
Figure 5 further presents qualitative comparisons on open complex prompts with larger and more diverse scene graphs.
Compared with the COCO-Stuff examples, these prompts contain more objects, attributes, and relational constraints, posing greater challenges for scene graph-based generation.
Graph2Scene consistently generates clear and coherent images while preserving multiple objects and their interactions, demonstrating its ability to generalize to complex scene structures.
In contrast, previous methods suffer from severe degradation when handling such complex inputs.
SGDiff can still generate some rough scene layouts, but the generated images remain highly blurred and fail to recover detailed object appearances.
For SG2IM, the model completely collapses and produces nearly black images under these open complex prompts.
This failure is mainly because SG2IM relies on a graph encoder and layout prediction pipeline learned from fixed training distributions, making it difficult to handle unseen graph compositions and substantially larger scene structures.

blocks.en: Appendix F Runtime Overhead Analysis
blocks.zh: 附录F 运行时间 间接费用分析

blocks.en: We conduct runtime experiments on a single NVIDIA L20 GPU to evaluate the computational overhead of Graph2Scene. The VLM planning stage uses Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct [ 30 ] , and all evaluation prompts are drawn from the ConceptMix benchmark [ 35 ] introduced in the main paper. All runtime measurements are averaged over five runs.
blocks.zh: 我们在一个单一的NVIDIA L20 GPU上进行运行时间实验,以评估Graph2Scene的计算间接费用. VLM规划阶段采用Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct [30],所有评价提示都来自主论文中引入的概念Mix基准[35]. 所有运行时间的测量平均为5次。

blocks.en: We investigate runtime overhead from two perspectives. First, we evaluate prompts with different lengths (200–400, 400–600, 600–800, and 800–1000 tokens) while keeping the image resolution fixed at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 . This experiment examines how prompt complexity affects both computational cost and compositional quality. Second, we fix the prompt length to 400–600 tokens and vary the image resolution from 512 × 512 512\times 512 to 1280 × 1280 1280\times 1280 to investigate resolution-dependent computational overhead. Since this second experiment focuses on runtime scaling, we report only runtime measurements in Table 3 (b). VLM-based quality metrics are evaluated and reported in the prompt scaling experiment in Table 3 (a), where the image resolution is fixed.
blocks.zh: 我们从两个角度调查运行时间。 首先,我们用不同的长度(200–400、400–600、600–800和800–1000令牌)来评估提示,同时将图像分辨率固定在1024×1024 1024\times 1024。 这一试验审查迅速的复杂性如何影响计算成本和组成质量。 其次,我们把快速长度固定到400–600个符,并将图像分辨率从512×512 512\times 512到1280×1280 1280\times 1280来调查依赖分辨率的计算间接费用. 由于第二次试验的重点是运行时间缩放,我们只在表3(b)中报告运行时间测量。 基于VLM的质量度量衡在图像分辨率固定的表3(a)的快速缩放实验中进行评估和报告。

blocks.en: We decompose Graph2Scene into four stages: (1) VLM Planning and Graph Construction , which converts the input prompt into a structured scene graph using Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct; (2) Warm-up and Attention Analysis , which performs an unguided generation pass to identify attention leakage and overlap; (3) Mask Construction , which builds selective attention masks based on graph connectivity and attention statistics; and (4) Final Image Generation , which performs graph-guided diffusion. We report the execution time of each stage as well as the total end-to-end latency, and compare Graph2Scene with Regional Prompt, the strongest baseline in our comparison. Unlike Graph2Scene, Regional Prompt does not require a separate warm-up pass or attention analysis stage. Therefore, its corresponding entry is marked as “–” (not applicable) rather than zero.

blocks.en: For LongBench-T2I, we use a VLM to evaluate the generated images in terms of object existence, attribute correctness, and relationship accuracy. Under these extremely long and complex prompts, all methods experience noticeable degradation: some required objects are omitted, attributes are incorrectly assigned or lost, and many relationships fail to appear in the generated scenes. This highlights the difficulty of faithfully following LongBench-T2I prompts with a large number of visual concepts and interactions. Nevertheless, Graph2Scene consistently preserves a larger proportion of the specified elements, attributes, and relationships than the compared methods. In particular, its advantage is more evident for attributes and relationships, indicating that explicitly organizing and controlling the interactions among scene elements helps maintain compositional consistency even when the prompt becomes highly complex.
blocks.zh: 对于Long Bench-T2I,我们用一个VLM来评价生成的图像在物体存在,属性正确性和关系精度方面. 在这些极其长而复杂的提示下,所有方法都经历了明显的降解:一些需要的对象被省略,属性被错误地指定或丢失,许多关系未能在生成的场景中出现. 这凸显了忠实地跟随LongBench-T2I的提示,有大量视觉概念和互动的难度. 尽管如此,Graph2Scene始终保留着比比较方法更大的特定元素,属性和关系. 特别是,它在属性和关系方面的优势更为明显,表明明确组织和控制场景要素之间的相互作用有助于保持结构上的一致性,即使瞬间变得非常复杂。
